spans.s:
वोर वोर, अस्, m. (probably not a Sanskrit
word), a sort of pulse, Dolichos Catjang.
—वोर-
पट्टी, f. a sort of mat or mattress for sleeping on
(perhaps made of the straw of the Vora).

वोरक वोरक, अस्, m. (= वोलक), a scribe,
writer.
वोरट वोरट, अस्, m. a sort of jasmine.

वोरव वोरव, अस्, m. a kind of rice (perhaps
that called Boro, which is cut in March or April).

वोरुखान वोरुखान, अस्, m. a horse (de-
scribed as one of a white and red colour).
